title: How is a grant recorded?
body:
The sources are silent on this. AssemblyAI#9's command set gives you `asmai grants` and `asmai grant revoke <id>` but no command that creates a grant, and gives leaders `asmai decision record`. AssemblyAI#10 says a grant attributed to you must cite your witnessed message (or, per AssemblyAI#12, a Lavish answer). Nothing says who records it.

The draft's interface table assumes A.
rec: A. It keeps the command set from AssemblyAI#9, and every grant has your own words behind it, on the same path as every other record attributed to you. B adds a second way to grant authority that bypasses Coordination's record of the conversation.
options: A: you give a grant in words; a leader records it with `asmai decision record` at its scope, citing your words (Coordination for one given in the conversation, the requesting leader for one given in an answer), and the daemon refuses it without a valid citation
B: add a command for you, `asmai grant <scope> …`, besides granting in the conversation

title: Accept 01 Roles and decisions?
body: Accepting applies your answer above and any annotations. I then commit the document and start 02 Daemon and store. If you would rather see the changes first, choose another round.
rec: A, unless your annotations change substance.
options: A: accept, with my answers and annotations applied
B: show me another round with the changes
